title: Where Stop-Motion Craft Meets Code: LAIKA’s ‘Wildwood’
subtitle: LAIKA’s Jeff Stringer and Jonathan Gerber share how "Wildwood" blends handcrafted stop motion with USD, 3D printing, and digital tools to bring Portland to life. The post Where Stop-Motion Craft Meets Code: LAIKA’s ‘Wildwood’ appeared first on ACM SIGGRAPH Blog.
